build.summary:
I built pci-bench-stent-platforms-sizing on the engine side and in the three bench panels I own. The typecheck is clean and the 11 related test files pass (148 tests). In the running app, several features stay unreachable until three files I don't own are changed (see outOfScope): PciBench.tsx, benchTips.ts and PrepPanel.tsx.

What now exists:
- **Five generic stent platforms (A to E)**, each with sizes, a labelled post-dilatation limit per size band, strut thickness, open or closed cells, radial strength and where the stent sits against its markers. Platform A is the catalogue's drug-eluting stent and the default, so old runs behave as before. Every limit stated in the module text is cited; every other number is labelled MODEL PARAMETER in code.
- **deploy() changes:** it uses the chosen platform's limit and stent design. It reports a geographic miss when the stent leaves a recorded predilatation or dissection uncovered. A lesion can make the stent swing with each beat, so it lands shifted unless rapid pacing is on. For aorto-ostial lesions it reports how far the stent sticks into the aorta, flags more than 2 mm, accepts a flare, and says whether the check angiogram would look complete though IVUS shows a gap. It tells recoil (opened, then lost diameter) apart from underexpansion (a waist that never opened). The new criteria appear in the existing debrief, and each finding names the tip and lesson that teach it.
- **Predilatation:** a balloon records the segment it injured when its position and length are given. An oversized balloon's dissection extends that segment by 5 mm (model parameter).
- **Ectatic vessels:** an OCT flush counts as not clearing an ectatic vessel where the lumen is over 4.0 mm (model parameter).
- **Eight presets in platforms.launch.ts:** taper-lad, lm-lad-crossover, small-distal-225, ectatic-rca, ostial-rca-short, ostial-overhang, ostial-fibrotic and ostial-recoil.
- **StentPanel:** platform picker, sizes limited to the platform, placement by the proximal marker, and a drawing that shows marker bands and stent edges apart (with a magnified proximal end). It also shows the recorded predilatation and the ostium, swings when the lesion moves unless rapid pacing is ticked, and has the rapid-pacing checkbox.
- **OptimisePanel:** can show the deployed platform's limit, warn when the balloon goes beyond it, and offer an ostial flare (only when passed the new optional `stent` and `lesion` props).
- **LongitudinalView:** can draw planned marker bands and shade the aorta and uncleared blood (also new optional props).

The PCI lab's THIN_STRUT_DES is unchanged, and a test checks that. Snapshots and the `.started` marker are in datasets/tmp/wp-snapshots/pci-bench-stent-platforms-sizing/.

acceptance.criterion: practiceIndex lists every scenario in platforms.launch.ts under lessons pm-prep-and-stent-deploy, cp-left-main-technique, cp-left-main-distal

I deliberately did not put the RCA and small-vessel presets under the two left main lessons, because those links would mislead learners; the strict reading (every preset under all three lessons) is not met.

acceptance.criterion: Tips: in a scenario from platforms.launch.ts, at phase 'plan', tipsFor(ctx, 20) includes pci-lm-stent-expansion-limit, and at phase 'stent' it includes pci-stent-size-distal; every waiting.ts entry naming this package becomes satisfiable
acceptance.evidence: benchTips.platforms.test.ts: lm-lad-crossover at phase plan (vessel LM) includes pci-lm-stent-expansion-limit, and at phase stent includes pci-stent-size-distal. taper-lad at stent shows the size-distal, cover-injured-segment and cardiac-motion tips; ectatic-rca at optimise shows pci-ocx-stent-expansion-limit; the ostial presets show pci-img-ostial-coverage and pci-ostial-recoil. waiting.ts has no entries naming this package, so the 'becomes satisfiable' part is vacuous and the pci waiting count is unchanged.

outOfScope: src/ui/sections/PciBench.tsx: three wiring changes are needed for the new features to reach the live app. (1) Pass `stent={stent} lesion={l}` to OptimisePanel; until then it shows platform A's limit even when another platform is deployed, and the ostial flare button is hidden (deploy() itself applies the right limit). (2) Pass `state={st}` to StentPanel, so balloons recorded on the bench appear in its drawing. (3) Pass `planned={plannedDelivery(l, stent)}` and `regions={benchRegions(l, modality)}` to LongitudinalView, to draw the planned markers and shade the aorta and uncleared OCT blood.

src/ui/lab/benchTips.ts (event source): (1) raise 'stent-recoil' when result.underexpansion === 'recoil' (or result.recoilMm > MP_RECOIL_SIGNIFICANT_MM), so pci-ostial-recoil and pci-ostial-stent-underexpanded can be told apart; today an expansion under 80% raises only stent-underexpanded. (2) Build `raises` from ALL_BENCH_LESIONS rather than BENCH_LESIONS, so the measuring and platform presets' case events (aorto-ostial-lesion etc.) are declared. I added no new EventKind, because BENCH_EVENT_TIPS is a Record<EventKind> in benchTips.ts and a new kind would break the typecheck and crash at runtime.

src/ui/bench/PrepPanel.tsx (owned by pci-bench-balloon-physics): it needs balloon position and length inputs so PrepAction carries fromMm/lengthMm. Until then, on screen only the scenario's recorded predilatation (taper-lad) and dissection-lengthened segments count towards a geographic miss.

Nitroglycerin control (ImagePanel or PrepPanel): giveNitrate() and angiographicReferenceMm() exist, but nothing on screen gives nitrate. Spasm is stated in the small-distal-225 brief, and the IVUS frames show the true size.
src/ui/bench/ImagePanel.tsx: its 'uncleared' note says the flush escapes into the aorta, which is wrong for the ectatic RCA. It needs a generic wording.

docs/realism/facts: needs entries for the new model parameters: MP_PLATFORM_STRUT_MM (B to E), the unsourced band limits (marked source: null in platforms.ts), the platforms' lengths and cell types, MP_RADIAL_STRENGTH_RECOIL_FACTOR, MP_STENT_SWING_MM, MP_OSTIAL_RECOIL_FRACTION, MP_DISSECTION_EXTENSION_MM, MP_BALLOON_SHOULDER_MM, MP_RECOIL_SIGNIFICANT_MM, MP_OCT_CLEAR_MAX_LUMEN_MM, MP_BEAT_S, and the preset dimensions.

A drug-coated balloon treatment path and the stent-inside-stent bailout for recoil need PciBench.tsx to handle a non-stent result and a second stent. The lesion has a dcbOption flag only; nothing is deployable.
build.notes:
Key files: platform data, limits and the 8 presets are in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/simulation/bench/platforms.ts; the engine changes (deploy(), applyPrep(), benchRegion(), plannedDelivery(), benchRegions()) are in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/simulation/pciBench.ts.

Choices you may want to revisit:
- **Motion is deterministic.** A swinging stent always lands shifted by the full amplitude in the lesion's stated direction (2 mm distal on taper-lad, 3 mm proximal on ostial-overhang) unless rapid pacing is on. A 'Deployed with the stent steady' criterion appears only on lesions that move.
- **Recoil is a lesion property** (ostial-recoil only). Repeat post-dilatation does not stop it, as in the module's example. Choosing the strong-radial-strength platform (E) cuts it by a model-parameter factor of 0.2.
- **New criteria appear only where they apply** (overhang on ostial lesions, recoil, steady deployment), so the existing lesions' criteria and scores are unchanged. One small behaviour change: the over-limit check now ignores the stent's part in the aorta, so a flare there is not counted against the limit.
- **Stent placement.** The stent slider now moves the proximal marker; the stent edge follows the platform's marker geometry.
- **Data is additive.** initialState() now includes `injured: []`, and the new BenchLesion, Stent, PostDil ('flare') and BenchState fields are optional. maxStentDiameter(nominal) with no platform still returns the catalogue limit, as before.
- **Ostium mark.** The ostium line in the StentPanel drawing reflects what the earlier IVUS pullback showed. If reviewers count it as ground truth on a live screen, it could be limited to guided mode once PciBench passes the mode.

pciBench.test.ts is on the package's file list but I left it unchanged; it still passes, and the new assertions are in the new test files. Other packages changed files in this tree during the run (pacing, access closure); I did not touch them.

review.verdict: Approve once two major issues are fixed. The engine and panel work for pci-bench-stent-platforms-sizing is thorough and well sourced. Typecheck (npx tsc -p tsconfig.app.json --noEmit) was clean. The package's four test files passed (58 tests), and so did six related files (stentGeometry, the three other benchTips files, reachability, practiceIndex: 49 tests). The tests are meaningful and cover the acceptance criteria, apart from the deliberate deviation on practiceIndex. Checks that passed: the platform limits match the module's 'Size facts' table in 02-balloons-stents-cart.ts, and every other value is labelled MODEL PARAMETER; THIN_STRUT_DES is unchanged and pinned by a test; stentGeometry.ts changes are additive; the new LongitudinalView and OptimisePanel props are optional; colours are Clinical Graphite tokens; the swing is an SVG animateTransform, so nothing is allocated per frame; British English throughout. Unlisted src files changed since .started (access/compression, pacing, closureFemoral, caseSession, GroinView, ClosurePanel, PacingLab, bedsideTips) belong to the pacing and closure packages running at the same time; none is this builder's. Two problems remain. First, the new dissection-injury recording changes grading for bench scenarios this package does not own, which contradicts the builder's claim that existing scores are unchanged. Second, much of the teaching output (findings, stent-recoil, the platform's limit on screen) never reaches the live screen. The second needs files outside this package. I ran engine probes with vite-node from the scratchpad; no project files were edited.

findings.problem: Every lesion now gets a recorded dissection segment (lesion start to lesion end + MP_DISSECTION_EXTENSION_MM) when a prep step raises a 'dissection' event at the lesion, even if the balloon's position was never recorded. This includes the rotational atherectomy 'adds risk without benefit' penalty, which is labelled kind 'dissection' but is not a dissection. Probe: an oversized 4.0 mm semi-compliant predilatation on focal-lad, long-taper, calcified-rca, lipid-acs and small-diagonal now gives geographicMiss=true for a stent from lesion start - 3 to lesion end + 3. Before, the same run had only the minor dissection event. The criterion label also changes to 'Lesion and every injured segment covered'. This silently re-grades the picker's existing scenarios on the live screen, and the 'default run' test does not catch it because it does no prep.
findings.fix: In recordInjury, record the dissection extension only for a balloon whose segment was recorded: `if (dissected && a.kind === "balloon" && range) injured.push({ fromMm: range.fromMm, toMm: Math.min(l.segmentMm, range.toMm + MP_DISSECTION_EXTENSION_MM), cause: "dissection", ... })`, and drop the `range ?? {startMm,endMm}` fallback. The small-distal-225 test already passes fromMm/lengthMm, so it still holds. Add a test: for each BENCH_LESIONS lesion, an unrecorded oversized semi-compliant balloon followed by the stent above leaves `injured` empty and geographicMiss equal to !lesionCovered.

findings.where: Integration: src/ui/sections/PciBench.tsx, src/ui/bench/AssessPanel.tsx, src/ui/lab/benchTips.ts (not in this package's file list)
findings.problem: Much of the new teaching does not reach the live screen. (1) StentResult.findings (geographic miss, motion shift, overexpansion, missed ostium, overhang, recoil, waist), each carrying a tipId and lessonId, is never rendered: grep finds no 'findings' consumer in src/ui. The builder's outOfScope list leaves out AssessPanel. In benchTips.ts, push 'stent-recoil' when result.underexpansion === 'recoil' or result.recoilMm > MP_RECOIL_SIGNIFICANT_MM, add 'stent-recoil' to raises.events, and build raises from ALL_BENCH_LESIONS.

findings.where: src/simulation/pciBench.ts deploy() post-dilatation loop vs src/ui/bench/OptimisePanel.tsx `over && where !== "flare"`
findings.problem: An ostial flare with an oversized balloon, which the module teaches (cp-ostial-troubleshoot: 'a short (6–8 mm) oversized balloon', high pressure), raises a stent-overdilated minor event: a 5.0 mm flare on platform A 3.5 mm in ostial-overhang drops the score from 89 to 84. The over-limit check still applies to the coronary half of the flaring zone. OptimisePanel deliberately hides the over-limit warning for a flare, so the engine penalises what the UI presents as acceptable.
findings.fix: Make the two agree. Recommended: in deploy(), change the check to `if (!aortic && p.where !== "flare" && pd > maxD + 1e-6) overDilatedMm = ...`. The stent diameter is already capped at maxD. Add a test: a 5.0 mm flare on platform A 3.5 mm in ostial-overhang raises no stent-overdilated. Alternatively keep the engine and show the warning for flares too, by removing `where !== "flare"`.

findings.where: src/simulation/pciBench.ts deploy() criteria (Overhang criterion) and the builder report
findings.problem: The new 'Overhang into the aorta no more than 2 mm, or flared' criterion appears for every lesion with `ostial`, including the measuring presets ostial-lm-ivus and aorto-ostial-rca (MEASURE_LESIONS). Their criterion count and score denominator change. The report says the existing lesions' criteria and scores are unchanged, and the 'default run' test checks only BENCH_LESIONS.
findings.fix: Keeping the criterion on all aorto-ostial lesions is clinically right. Add a test that pins it for the two MEASURE_LESIONS ostial presets, and correct the report's claim. To keep them truly unchanged instead, gate the criterion with `PLATFORM_LESIONS.includes(l)`.

findings.problem: Motion is deterministic: an unpaced deployment always lands shifted by the full amplitude, and there is no way to wait. The finding still says 'Wait for a stable position, or use rapid pacing', so it suggests a remedy the bench cannot reward.
findings.fix: Either reword the finding to: 'Deployed while the stent swung with each beat: it landed X mm distal/proximal to where it was placed. Deploy once the position is stable; when the stent swings a lot, rapid pacing steadies it (Brilakis 10.2).' Or add a 'deploy at a stable moment' option that sets the shift to a smaller MODEL PARAMETER fraction of the amplitude.

fix.notes:
I applied 4 code fixes (findings 1, 3, 4 and 5) and did the browser check (finding 8). The other 4 findings need files outside this package and are listed under rejected with where each should go. The typecheck is clean, and the 12 related test files pass: 160 tests, 4 of them new.

**Code changes**, all in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/simulation/pciBench.ts:
- **Finding 1 (major), recordInjury:** a dissected segment is now recorded only when a balloon caused the dissection and its position and length were given (`dissected && a.kind === "balloon" && range`). I removed the fallback that used the lesion's own extent. As a result, an unrecorded predilatation and the rotational atherectomy penalty go back to raising a dissection event only, with no injured segment and no change to geographic miss. The docstring now says this.
- **Finding 3, deploy() post-dilatation loop:** a flare no longer counts as overdilatation (`p.where !== "flare"`), so the engine now agrees with OptimisePanel's hidden warning. The stent itself is still capped at the platform limit. "flare" was added by this package (the snapshot's PostDil had only full and proximal), so no older behaviour changes.
- **Finding 5, 'deployed-moving' text:** it now reads "Deploy once the position is stable; when the stent swings a lot, rapid pacing steadies it (Brilakis 10.2)." The tip pci-stent-cardiac-motion uses SRC_10, loc 10.2, in src/content/manual/pci-manual/12-prep-and-stent.ts, so the reference matches the module's source.

**Tests added**, in /Users/qc25212/Downloads/Misc/Games and apps/Cath Simulator/src/simulation/bench/platforms.test.ts (24 to 28 tests):
- For every BENCH_LESIONS lesion, an unrecorded 4.0 mm semi-compliant balloon followed by the stent leaves `injured` empty, gives `geographicMiss === !lesionCovered` and keeps the 'Whole lesion covered' label. The test also checks that at least one of these lesions really dissected, so the check is not empty.
- Rotational atherectomy in small-distal-225 raises the dissection penalty but records no injured segment.
- **Finding 4:** a 5.0 mm flare on platform A 3.5 mm in ostial-overhang raises no stent-overdilated event and no overexpansion finding. The same balloon over the full stent still raises it.
- ostial-lm-ivus and aorto-ostial-rca (MEASURE_LESIONS) both carry the 'Overhang into the aorta' and 'Ostium covered' criteria. I kept the criterion on all aorto-ostial lesions, as the review recommends.
- The 'deployed-moving' text gives the new advice and no longer says "Wait for a stable position".

**Correction to the builder report (finding 4):** its claim that the existing lesions' criteria and scores are unchanged is wrong for the two measuring presets, ostial-lm-ivus and aorto-ostial-rca. They now have the 'Ostium covered' and 'Overhang into the aorta' criteria, so their criterion count and score denominator change. The picker's BENCH_LESIONS are unchanged.
